phrases.latin: Theodōrus pittam cum cucurbitulīs, melongēnīs, piperītidibus rubrīs poposcit, nōn per patrem sed ipse, digitō in imāginem intentō.
phrases.english: Theo asked for the pitta with courgettes, aubergines and red peppers, not through Dad but himself, pointing at the picture.
phrases.source: Libellus VI, Reditus: per Alpēs domum

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 98, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
